image_description: A white minibus (likely a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar model) parked on a paved brick surface. The vehicle is angled towards the left, showing its front and right side. It features a high roof, a row of tinted side windows, standard alloy wheels, and a sliding door track visible on the side panel. There are some decals/logos on the hood and side. Background includes a building with scaffolding and some greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from full-size buses, with proportions consistent with a minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield and three distinct side windows for passengers are clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is significant relative to its width. The driver's door is at the front, and the sliding passenger door is located at the mid-body.
The seam and handle mechanism for a sliding door are visible on the side panel behind the driver's door.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the angle of the photograph; only the side and front are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with visible logos/decals on the hood and side, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, appearing to be standard alloy rims with realistic tire tread and shadowing.
The window configuration (3 side windows) suggests seating capacity consistent with the 4-10 passenger range.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model classification and ensure it aligns with the 'minibus' label rather than a standard van or full-size bus.
To verify the structural rigidity of the vehicle body and ensure correct spatial separation from the background building and pavement.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts around complex boundaries like wheel wells and window frames.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the paintwork or reflections that might indicate AI generation.

focus_areas: Window frame straightness and perspective consistency
Reflections on the windshield and body panels
Boundary sharpness between tires and pavement
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text/logos on the side and hood. AI often generates gibberish text. Verify if the logos look like plausible brand markings or nonsensical artifacts. Also, inspect the side mirror structure for any melting or floating elements.
